$comment: Merged over your global ~/.claude/settings.json for this agent's runs (hq --settings). Placeholders: {{HQ}}, {{AGENT_DIR}} (pinned package), {{AGENTS}}, {{PACKAGE}} (live package: skills/learned/), {{HOME_DIR}} (memory, data, files), {{HOME_REAL}} (same, symlinks resolved). bin/hq adds: memory, learned skills and shared project files writable; secrets denied. Runs start in bypassPermissions (permissions.defaultMode, a suggestion the installer accepts or overrides); HQ_PERMISSION_MODE overrides, and hq:coder subagents use the caller's mode. Deny rules still apply in bypass. Deny rules are a backstop for the rules in agent.md (Bash prefixes can be worded around); the real guard for the default branch is branch protection on GitHub. env: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE 40 compacts the live session at 40% of its auto-compact window (Claude Code 2.1.302: threshold = min(window x 40%, window - 13k); about 39% of the 1M context Ctx shows); job files keep the state across it.
